# Trilochan Manpower Supply
> The working model of Trilochan, founded by A.J, is built around a comprehensive, multi-sector manpower supply and resource management framework. It functions as a structured bridge between organizations needing reliable staff and individuals seeking employment across various domains. 
> The platform is engineered and developed by The Auzent (founded by Ashutosh Kaushal).

## Key Services
1. Placement Service: Long-term corporate, technical, logistics, and hospitality staffing.
2. On-Demand / Gig Workforce: Fast, local, and on-call support for short-term projects.
